title: Meet the toolbox
goal: Find three core tools and draw your first line.

steps.say: Welcome! In about two minutes you will find three tools in Illustrator's toolbox. Dydact highlights each one on your screen. Click the highlight to continue.
The Selection tool picks and moves whole objects. Click the highlighted tool.
The Pen tool draws precise paths from anchor points. Click the highlighted tool.
Now try it: click two different spots on the canvas to draw a straight line. Press 'I did it' when you are done.
Picking another tool ends the line. The Zoom tool magnifies the view: click the highlighted tool, then click the canvas.

summary: You found the Selection, Pen and Zoom tools and drew a line. Tip: you can type any tool's name in Query mode and Dydact will show you where it is.
